scope: ten-question engineering diagnostic, manual Codex judgments

criteria.task_complete: Substantively answers the current request or asks for essential information genuinely unavailable in the full visible history. General advice may satisfy an open-ended request; do not require matching the reference words or gratuitous personal detail.
criteria.source_consistent: No unsupported personal history, ownership error, or reliance on a withdrawn detail; a current explicit request may revisit the topic. Check raw user statements when notes make questionable assertions.
criteria.supported_in_visible_state: Personal claims must be supported by the actual supplied notes/recent/tool text, not merely happen to be true in the archive. General recommendations are not claims about remembered preferences.
criteria.contextual_value: Record separately whether correct contextual detail materially improves the answer. Do not turn a stylistic preference into an accuracy gain.
criteria.protocol_valid: ANSWER message, nonempty body, EOS before cap; malformed or truncated answers fail regardless of content.

acceptable_definition: protocol_valid AND task_complete AND source_consistent AND supported_in_visible_state
routing: For each of states zero and one retrieval, choose answer-now when acceptable; otherwise retrieve only if a later captured state is acceptable. No later acceptable answer means action target is masked. This is development labeling, not trained policy behavior.
blindness: Reference version frozen before capture; judgments see actual evidence and complete answer, no policy checkpoint exists. Reviewer is not independent of reference author.
